from pathlib import Path
import json
import logging
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

import chess
import chess.engine

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
from perpetual_check_validation import safe, sha
from human_play_tests import FakeFactory
from play_human import HumanGame
import engine_pacing

binary = ROOT / "build/runtime-engines/5011da4c5e6ef01c452bd7125e4e22b372d2c9cfb858ed8759057325acb0e6ba/regicide.exe"
output = ROOT / "docs/checks/2026-11-04-perpetual-check/deeper-search-host-smoke.json"
log = output.with_suffix(".uci.log")
assert not output.exists() and not log.exists()
fen = "r4k2/2p5/1pqp4/5r2/p3R2R/2B3P1/PP3P1P/6K1 b - - 3 31"
source_paths = [Path(__file__), ROOT / "scripts/play_human.py", ROOT / "scripts/engine_pacing.py",
                ROOT / "scripts/game_clock.py", ROOT / "tests/human_play_tests.py", binary]
report = {"schema": "regicide.gambit-deeper-host-smoke.v1", "binary": str(binary),
          "fen": fen, "seed": "gambit-deeper-search-v1", "time_control": "10+0",
          "source_sha256": {str(p): sha(p) for p in source_paths},
          "driver_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
          "scope": "Real HumanGame, real native selector, fake hint/evaluation peers, temporary saves",
          "limitations": ["One integration smoke; no strength or perpetual-check resolution claim",
                          "Custom FEN omits unrelated optional candidate selection and private game history"],
          "calls": [], "status": "failed"}
handler = logging.FileHandler(log, mode="x", encoding="utf-8")
handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s"))
logger = logging.getLogger("chess.engine")
logger.addHandler(handler)
logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
engines = []
def factory(path):
    kwargs = {"creationflags": subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW} if os.name == "nt" else {}
    engine = chess.engine.SimpleEngine.popen_uci([str(path), "uci"], timeout=10, **kwargs)
    analysis = engine.analysis
    def observed(board, limit, **options):
        report["calls"].append({"fen": board.fen(en_passant="fen"), "history_uci": [m.uci() for m in board.move_stack],
                                "time_seconds": limit.time, "depth": limit.depth, "nodes": limit.nodes})
        return analysis(board, limit, **options)
    engine.analysis = observed
    engines.append(engine)
    return engine

game = None
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="regicide-deeper-host-smoke-") as directory:
        game = HumanGame(binary, Path(directory) / "games", factory,
                         hint_engine_factory=FakeFactory(), evaluation_engine_factory=FakeFactory(),
                         opening_variety_enabled=False)
        game.new_game("white", 1000, game.revision, boss_mode=True, time_control="10+0")
        game.board = chess.Board(fen)
        game._clock.restore_ply(0, "black")
        game._opening_seed = report["seed"]
        game.revision += 1
        game._sync_evaluation()
        before = game.board.copy(stack=True)
        report["before_clock"] = game._clock.snapshot()
        start = time.monotonic()
        state = game.engine_move(game.revision)
        report["wall_elapsed_ms"] = round((time.monotonic() - start) * 1000, 3)
        report["state_error"] = state["error"]
        report["played_uci"] = game.board.peek().uci() if game.board.move_stack else None
        report["played_legal"] = bool(game.board.move_stack and game.board.peek() in before.legal_moves)
        report["after_fen"] = game.board.fen(en_passant="fen")
        report["after_clock"] = game._clock.snapshot()
        report["actual_movetimes_ms"] = game._engine_movetimes.copy()
        report["pacing_receipt"] = safe(game._engine_pacing_decisions.get(1))
        report["saved_files"] = [p.name for p in (Path(directory) / "games").iterdir() if p.is_file()]
        receipt = report["pacing_receipt"]
        assert state["error"] is None and report["played_legal"]
        assert len(report["calls"]) == 1
        assert receipt["allocation"]["deeper_search"]["active"] is True
        assert receipt["allocation"]["baseline_ms"] > 3000
        assert report["calls"][0]["time_seconds"] * 1000 == receipt["allocation"]["baseline_ms"]
        game.close()
        game = None
        report["temporary_saves_only"] = True
        report["status"] = "recorded"
except Exception as error:
    report["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
finally:
    if game is not None:
        game.close()
    report["process_exit_codes"] = [e.returncode.result(timeout=3) for e in engines]
    report["all_native_closed"] = all(code == 0 for code in report["process_exit_codes"])
    report["sources_unchanged"] = report["source_sha256"] == {str(p): sha(p) for p in source_paths}
    if not report["all_native_closed"] or not report["sources_unchanged"]:
        report["status"] = "failed"
    logger.removeHandler(handler)
    handler.close()
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({key: report.get(key) for key in ("status", "error", "wall_elapsed_ms", "played_uci", "calls", "sources_unchanged", "all_native_closed")}), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if report["status"] == "recorded" else 1)
scope: Real HumanGame, real native selector, fake hint/evaluation peers, temporary saves
limitations: One integration smoke; no strength or perpetual-check resolution claim
Custom FEN omits unrelated optional candidate selection and private game history
